title: A Model-Theoretic Formalization of AlKhwaremis ilm alfaraid
abstract: arXiv:2610.33629v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper presents a model theoretic and computational formalization of AlKhwarizmis treatment of inheritance within the framework of Computational Fiqh. We first show that every inheritance configuration in a specified class is representable as a finite system of rational linear equalities and inequalities, and that such systems are decided exactly by Fourier Motzkin elimination over Q. We then define the fixed dimensional inheritance structure Vd with distinguished claimant coordinates, and prove that every admissible rational linear coordinate realization is isomorphic to Vd, this establishes the algebraic representation as canonical within that class. The complete first order theory Td of Vd is shown to be complete by construction and is explicitly distinguished from the decidability of the inheritance relevant fragment. translated_title: 花拉子密遗产继承学（'ilm al-farā'iḍ）的模型论形式化
translated_abstract: 本文在计算法理学的框架下，对花拉子密关于遗产继承问题的处理方法给出了模型论与计算层面的形式化。我们首先证明，某一特定类别中的每一种继承配置都可以表示为一个由有理数上的线性等式与不等式构成的有限系统，并且此类系统可以精确地通过 Q 上的傅里叶-莫茨金（Fourier-Motzkin）消元法加以判定。随后，我们定义了具有特定权利主张人坐标的固定维度继承结构 V_d，并证明每一个容许的有理线性坐标实现均与 V_d 同构，从而确立了该代数表示在此类别中的规范性（正则性）。我们通过构造证明了 V_d 的完整一阶理论 T_d 的完备性，并明确将其与继承相关片段的可判定性区分开来。最后，本文将这一方法论原则与通过对封闭法理学领域进行穷尽分析而实现的更广泛形式化纲领联系起来。
tldr: 本文用模型论方法将花拉子密的伊斯兰遗产继承规则形式化为有理数上的线性等式与不等式系统，证明其可由傅里叶-莫茨金消元法精确判定，并确立了规范继承结构 V_d 及其完备的一阶理论。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes Al-Khwarizmi's Islamic inheritance rules as finite systems of rational linear equalities and inequalities, decidable exactly by Fourier-Motzkin elimination, and establishes the canonical fixed-dimensional inheritance structure V_d together with its complete first-order theory.
